deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027, with all materials and letters in; late or incomplete applications are generally not considered.
deadline.quote: The Fall 2027 deadline for PhD applications is December 1, 2026.

gre_subject.value: Neither the GRE General nor the Mathematics Subject GRE is required.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE general test and mathematics subject test are not required.

gre_general.value: The GRE General is not required.
gre_general.quote: The GRE general test and mathematics subject test are not required.

toefl_min.value: Math needs TOEFL iBT 95 total with at least 22 in speaking (old scale); teaching in a classroom needs a higher spoken-English standard.
toefl_min.quote: The Mathematics Department requires a minimum TOEFL iBT speak score of 22 (or IELTS 6.5 speaking score) and a minimum TOEFL total of 95 for admission to the PhD program.

supervisor.value: The pages checked describe a coursework-then-thesis PhD but say nothing about choosing an advisor before applying.

funding.value: PhD students are generally offered a 50% teaching assistantship at admission, with full tuition waiver and a stipend (about USD 24,620 for 2025-26).
funding.quote: PhD students are generally offered a position as a "50% teaching assistant" at the time of admission.

entry_route.value: Apply directly to the PhD with a strong undergraduate maths background; a master's can be earned along the way.
entry_route.quote: Students who wish to earn a doctorate should apply directly to the PhD program. Students can usually earn a Masters degree along the way to the PhD.

notes: IELTS speaking 6.5 is required (overall not stated). Fee waivers only for some US applicants.
